changes.evidence: In Blade: Trinity Dr. Edgar Vance is one of Danica Talos's human familiars: Police chief Martin Vreede (filed under The House of Talos) calls in his colleague Vance, who declares Blade psychotic so the authorities will hand him over to the vampires ('The vampires' familiars have arranged for the authorities to turn Blade over to them'). He serves the house just as Vreede does, which is a membership the record leaves out.

In S1 Blake is campaign staff and then a City Hall aide from episode 1 ('Heaven's Half Hour'), and he becomes Deputy Mayor for Communications in episode 8. All of that is Fisk's administration. Nothing in S1 has him serving Fisk's criminal organization before the administration or leaving it and then rejoining, which is what the Empire > administration > Empire order inside S1 says. He is brought into the criminal side in S2: in episode 4 Cashman makes him help bury Savva's body, and he is 'brought further into the fold of Fisk's organization' under Cashman. In episode 7 he turns on Fisk by letting BB escape, and Cashman kills him, so the Independent/left at S2 stands.

owner_calls.question: Employer: should Topher get a past stage at Goodman University? On screen he is said to have worked there as a janitor and to have been at the clean-up of the Geosciences Research Center explosion, where he found the rocks.
options: Add a past stage 'Goodman University' keyed to Runaways S1–S2, first
Leave it out (a minor past job)
owner_calls.evidence: Runaways S2E5 'Rock Bottom' (episode 15): his family's backstory. The MCU wiki lists Goodman University (formerly) as his affiliation, and Marvel Database says he was 'working at a clean-up of the explosion'.

owner_calls.question: The Recruiter works for Ajax's organization in Deadpool, recruiting Wade for the program. The name of that group is held ('The Workshop'). Once the owner settles the name, should the Recruiter get it as a stage from the start?
options: Add Ajax's group (under the name the owner settles) from the start
owner_calls.evidence: Deadpool (2016): he recruits Wade for Ajax's program, and later Wade tracks him down as one of Ajax's associates. Marvel Database lists his affiliation as 'Ajax's organization'.
